summary: Exact corresponding sources for copyleft libraries that third-party wheels bundle into LocalSR's worker. build_source_bundle.py requires them via --extra-source.

libraw.component: LibRaw 0.22.1 (LGPL-2.1 or CDDL-1.0), bundled by rawpy 0.27.0
libraw.note: The sdist contains external/LibRaw at the bundled version.

gcc-runtime.component: libquadmath (LGPL-2.1) from GCC 11.3.0, bundled by NumPy 1.26.4's OpenBLAS
gcc-runtime.evidence: numpy v1.26.4 tools/wheels/gfortran_utils.sh downloads gfortran from isuruf/gcc release gcc-11.3.0-2; tools/openblas_support.py selects openblas ...macosx_11_0_arm64-gf_5272328.

gcc-runtime-linux.component: libquadmath (LGPL-2.1) from CentOS 7's GCC 4.8.5-44, bundled by NumPy 1.26.4's manylinux2014 wheel
gcc-runtime-linux.evidence: numpy-1.26.4-cp311-cp311-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl ships numpy.libs/libquadmath-96973f99.so.0.0.0 next to an OpenBLAS whose objects carry 'GCC: (GNU) 4.8.5 20150623 (Red Hat 4.8.5-44)' and '10.2.1 (Red Hat 10.2.1-11)'. manylinux2014 is CentOS 7.9, where devtoolset-10 links libquadmath.so.0 from the system libquadmath package built from gcc-4.8.5-44.el7; libgfortran (GPL-3.0 with the runtime exception) needs no source.

gcc-runtime-windows.component: libquadmath (LGPL-2.1) from GCC 10.3.0, statically linked into NumPy 1.26.4's Windows OpenBLAS DLL
gcc-runtime-windows.evidence: numpy-1.26.4-cp311-cp311-win_amd64.whl ships numpy.libs/libopenblas64__v0.3.23-293-gc2f4bdbb-gcc_10_3_0-*.dll, whose objects carry 'GCC: (Built by Jeroen for the R-project) 10.3.0' and quadmath symbols; that toolchain builds GCC 10.3.0.
